description: Jitter Plot Convergent Business Technologies · Free · All features included When analysts need to see every individual data point, standard charts fall short. Jitter Plot draws every observation as a dot within category lanes, making overlapping points visible rather than hidden. Jitter mode applies a random offset for density clouds. Beeswarm mode uses force-directed packing for overlap-free violin-like shapes. Currency and percentage detection and conditional colours are built in. Key Capabilities Individual Data Points — Every observation as a dot within category swim lanes Jitter & Beeswarm Modes — Random spread for density clouds or force-packed overlap-free shapes Density & Format Controls — Adjustable jitter and beeswarm padding with currency and percentage detection Conditional Colour — Numeric rules or field-value colour mapping Axis Range & Reference Bands — Configurable min/max axis limits and unlimited shaded bands with colour, opacity, and labels Small Multiples — Trellis grid with axis coupling and range matching Full Power BI Interactivity — Cross-filtering, drill-down, drill-through, tooltips, gridlines, and context menus Coming Soon Upcoming releases will introduce dot shape options, a density heatmap overlay, and a violin outline for beeswarm.
